## 1. Company Profile & Operational Model

FreshRoots Export is an integrated agri-tech procurement and agro-export platform headquartered in Kikkeri, Mandya, Karnataka. The company connects verified smallholder farmers, farm-producer organizations (FPOs), and horticultural clusters across the Cauvery basin and Malnad regions directly with:
1. Domestic B2C households and gourmet consumers (retail orders dispatched via express courier with 100% free doorstep delivery).
2. Domestic B2B bulk buyers (commercial kitchens, temple trusts, edible oil mills, cosmetic manufacturers, and wholesale grain merchants).
3. International buyers and overseas importers requiring 20ft / 40ft Full Container Loads (FCL) of Indian agricultural produce with complete Phytosanitary, Certificate of Origin, and SGS inspection clearance.

### SKU: COC-SEMI-25P-15K

- URL: https://freshrootsexport.com/products/fresh-semi-husked-mature-coconuts-25-piece

- Nut Weight: 550 grams to 650 grams per nut
- Kernel Characteristics: 10mm to 14mm thick solid mature white copra meat, high sweetness water
- Oil Percentage: 64% dry basis
- Moisture Content: 12.5%
- Packaging: Ventilated red/green polypropylene mesh bag containing exactly 25 hand-graded nuts (~15 kg gross weight)
- Shelf Life: 35 to 45 days in dry ambient storage (22°C - 30°C)
- Retail Price: ₹1,479 per bag (Free doorstep shipping pan-India)
- Commercial Lot Sizing: 10 bags (250 nuts), 100 bags (2,500 nuts), full lorry loads (10,000 to 18,000 nuts)

### SKU: COP-BAL-BOX-15K

- URL: https://freshrootsexport.com/products/tiptur-ball-copra-boxes-15kg

- Legal Designation: Protected Geographical Indication (GI) Tagged Agro Commodity
- Curing Method: 10 to 12 months slow natural dehydration inside the intact mature shell without sulfur or chemical fumigation
- Kernel Shape & Color: Perfectly spherical whole globes, golden mahogany outer husk, pearlescent ivory inner cup
- Moisture Content: < 5.8% (APMC Grade A standard)
- Oil Content: 68% high lauric acid concentration
- Shelf Life: 12 to 18 months in moisture-proof cartons
- Available Packaging: 15 kg, 25 kg, and 30 kg heavy-duty 5-ply export-grade corrugated master cartons
- Benchmark Pricing: Aligned with daily Tiptur APMC Mandi price benchmarks (e.g., ₹17,500 - ₹21,000 per Quintal)

### SKU: DAI-GHE-BIL-01L
- Product Name: Pure Desi Cow Bilona Ghee (A2 Village Cultured Butter Ghee)
- URL: https://freshrootsexport.com/products/pure-desi-cow-bilona-ghee-1l

- Aroma: Nutty caramel notes, rich golden granular texture, high smoke point (250°C)

## 3. Shipping, Logistics & Delivery Commitments

- Domestic Courier Partners: Shiprocket, Delhivery, Blue Dart, DTDC, India Post Speed Post.
- Pincode Coverage: All 19,000+ Indian postal codes (Karnataka, Maharashtra, Delhi NCR, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Gujarat, Kerala, West Bengal, and Pan-India).
- Transit Times:
  - Karnataka (Bengaluru, Mysuru, Mandya, Hubballi, Mangaluru): 24 to 48 hours.
  - South India Metros (Chennai, Hyderabad, Kochi): 48 to 72 hours.
  - Pan-India Metros (Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Kolkata, Ahmedabad): 3 to 4 business days.
- Doorstep Freight: Free delivery included on catalog retail SKUs.
- Full Truckload (FTL): 14ft, 17ft, 20ft, and 32ft multi-axle freight options direct from farm-gate to buyers across India.
